description: This file contains the implementation of the EventHubAdapterReceiver class, which handles receiving messages from Azure Event Hubs within the Orleans streaming framework. It manages initialization, message retrieval, cache management, and lifecycle operations for Event Hub partitions. It also defines the EventHubPartitionSettings class which encapsulates configuration details for a specific Event Hub partition.

classes.name: EventHubPartitionSettings
classes.description: Encapsulates configuration options for a specific Event Hub partition, including hub settings, receiver options, and the partition identifier.

classes.name: EventHubAdapterReceiver
classes.description: Implements the Orleans IQueueAdapterReceiver and IQueueCache interfaces to manage receiving, caching, and lifecycle operations for Event Hub partitions in the Orleans streaming environment.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the receiver, establishing connections and loading checkpoint state.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Fetches a list of message batches up to maxCount from the Event Hub partition.

methods.name: AddToCache
methods.description: No-op in this implementation; cache is updated directly.

methods.name: TryPurgeFromCache
methods.description: Signals the cache to purge old data if not under pressure.

methods.name: GetCacheCursor
methods.description: Returns a cursor for iterating over cached messages.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Determines if the receiver is under pressure based on max add count.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the receiver, closing connections and disposing resources.
